subject: POC workshop & capacity planning — scheduling and reschedule
messages:
From: Andrew Li <andrew@skylark.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — capacity questions

Connor —

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. We'd like to get a POC kickoff scheduled next week and include a hands-on working session focused on prompt review, routing (to 3rd-party enrichers), and a short load test to validate token budgets. A few constraints from our side:

- We'd prefer a 90-minute workshop so we can run through prompts and then run a 15–20 minute load test.
- Our infra team will want to confirm whether we should trial Hosted or Dedicated (short term) — key questions: quota bumps, rate limits, and expected token/second budgets for peak periods.
- Attaching a short requirements doc with sample prompts and expected QPS.

Can you share available slots and a proposed agenda? Also let us know if Redwood can temporarily raise trial quotas for the load test or if Dedicated trial is needed.

Thanks,
Andrew Li
Head of Platform Integrations
Skylark Analytics

Attachment: poc_requirements.pdf (18 KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Li <andrew@skylark.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — capacity questions

Hi Andrew —

Great summary, thanks. We can run the 90-minute format and build the session around three parts: prompt/narrowing review (30m), routing and integration mapping (30m), and a focused load test (30m).

Two immediate asks from our side before we lock a slot:
1) Can you confirm expected peak concurrent users (or sessions) and average prompt length (tokens)?
2) Do you have a preference for Hosted vs Dedicated trial? If you expect sustained high QPS and want isolation for the load test, Dedicated trial is recommended — otherwise we can support quota bumps on Hosted for short windows.

Open slots next week:
- Tue 29 Jun, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 30 Jun, 13:00–14:30 PT

I've attached a proposed agenda and a short pre-call checklist. Marissa will run the load-test plan; Aditya will cover routing and model/profile recommendations.

If either slot works, we can send a calendar invite and a short pre-work form to capture the token/QPS numbers.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_proposed_agenda.md (3 KB)

From: Andrew Li <andrew@skylark.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Ortiz <megan@skylark.ai>, infra-team@skylark.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — capacity questions

Connor —

Thanks — Wed 30 Jun at 13:00 PT works best for our team, but we need to move the calendar due to an exec conflict. Can we shift to Thu 1 Jul, 09:30–11:00 PT instead? That gives our SRE a little more time to prepare.

Quick answers to your pre-asks:
- Peak concurrent sessions: ~40 (internal usage model)
- Avg prompt length: ~1,200 tokens; we have a small subset with ~4k tokens for long-form summarization
- Expected peak sustained QPS during load test: ~8–10 QPS (short 10–15 minute window)

Regarding Hosted vs Dedicated: for the load test we would prefer Hosted if Redwood can provide a temporary quota bump (per-minute and per-second limits) and confirm that KV/prefix caching will function the same in Hosted. If not, we should provision a short Dedicated trial.

Megan (cc'd) — can your team confirm any internal calendar constraints for Thu morning?

Appreciate it — attaching an updated capacity spreadsheet with token distribution.

Andrew

Attachment: capacity_matrix.xlsx (5 KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Li <andrew@skylark.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on workshop — capacity questions

Andrew —

Thu 1 Jul 09:30–11:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Calendar invite incoming. Quick notes and pre-work to keep the session focused:

Pre-call asks (please paste answers into the shared doc):
- Confirm top 10 prompts (sample input + expected output) so Marissa can prepare caching and batching rules.
- Confirm your auth/integration path (API key vs VPC peering) — if you choose VPC/Dedicated we need to coordinate networking a day earlier.
- Confirm whether any prompts need long attention spans (>2k tokens) so we can pick a model variant and quantization profile.
- Confirm the exact time window for the load test and whether we should throttle to 10 QPS or run an open ramp.

Operational notes:
- For Hosted trials we can apply a time-limited quota bump for the 15-minute load window; it requires approval but we've done this before.
- If you want Dedicated isolation we can stand up a short trial (48–72 hours) but that requires a signed short-term SLA commitment. We can discuss on the call.

Related doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_example_shared_poc_notes (please add samples by EOD Wed).

Attachment: draft-network-map.png (PNG, 220 KB)

Looking forward to the workshop — see you Thu.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
